**Management Summary – Project LV 219,568 €**

The audit identified 9 high‑risk duplicate line items (total ≈ 45 k€) that could lead to double billing, notably in the “Baustelleneinrichtung”, soil handling, and frost‑protection categories. Two medium‑risk issues involve lump‑sum quantities that violate VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1, risking contract non‑compliance (≈ 5.6 k€). Additional medium‑risk gaps include missing technical specifications (asphalt class, compaction, paving dimensions, insulation data, and landfill details) and an unusually low unit price for sub‑base excavation (3.5 k€), suggesting possible under‑pricing. Immediate actions: consolidate duplicate positions, correct lump‑sum entries, enrich missing specifications, and review unit‑price benchmarks to safeguard cost integrity and contractual compliance.
